description.p: DotMorph is a file converter for Linux with an animated radial menu. Select files, open the wheel and pick the target format: more than 440 conversions for images, PDF, SVG, video, audio, Office documents and Markdown, using the tools already on your system.

ul.li: Two-ring wheel drawn on the GPU, with an edge dock like Android's edge panels
Right-click actions in Nautilus, Thunar, Dolphin and Nemo, and a global hotkey
Compress, resize, rotate, strip metadata, mute video, merge into one PDF
Fit photos, videos, songs and PDFs under 10, 16 or 25 MB for Discord, WhatsApp or e-mail
OCR: text from screenshots and scans, or a searchable PDF
Offline transcription of audio and video to text and subtitles with whisper.cpp
Soft UI sounds that are easy to turn off
Watch folders that convert new files automatically
In English, Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Turkish, with dark, light and glass themes
Fully local: no uploads, no telemetry
